Overview

Build at the intersection of history.

While India's AI leaders take the global stage at the AI Impact Summit, something electric is happening in New Delhi. 300 builders (developers, founders, product managers, designers, people who've never written a line of code) are gathering for 40 hours to build AI products that ship.

What you're walking into: VibeCon India — February 21st (8 AM) to February 22nd (8:30 PM) at IIT Delhi, New Delhi.

40 hours to build AI products that solve real problems across social impact, climate, health, education, and productivity.

You'll get hands-on mentorship from India's top founders and engineers. You can apply solo or bring a team of up to 4 people. You'll push harder than you thought possible and walk away with something you actually shipped.

What's at stake:

  • 🏆 25 lakhs prize pool for the winning teams
  • 🌟 Visibility within India's AI and startup ecosystem
  • 🤝 Mentorship from top founders and engineers
  • 💼 Real connections with investors and industry leaders

The summit puts Indian AI on the map. This hackathon is where you prove you belong there.

Registration closes February 18th. 300 spots available. First come, first serve. Free entry.

Don't sit this one out.

Themes

Solve Any Real-World Problem

This theme gives you the freedom to choose your own problem and create an innovative solution. • 💡 Bring your most creative ideas • 🌍 Tackle any real-world challenge you care about • 🛠️ Use any technology – AI, Web, Mobile, Blockchain, IoT, etc. • 🎯 Focus on making a strong social, economic, or environmental impact
